name: Professor Quackerton in: The Locked Birdhouse
source:
Professor Quackerton regales you with a tale of her youth. When a dear friend passes, there is little to be done, but to celebrate her life. Trouble is, everything seems to be going wrong.

[From [url=https://whatnames.itch.io/quackerton-locked-birdhouse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夸克顿教授绘声绘色地讲起自己年轻时的往事。挚友离世后，能做的已然不多，唯有纪念她的一生。问题是，一切似乎都在出岔子。

[摘自[url=https://whatnames.itch.io/quackerton-locked-birdhouse]itch.io[/url]]
